name: medicine-and-pharmacology-fundamentals
description: Fundamentals of Medicine and Pharmacology: how to read this field, homeostasis and physiological organization, drug targets, pathophysiology, clinical reasoning, diagnostic testing and its Bayesian logic, pharmacokinetics, pharmacodynamics, dose-response and the therapeutic window, drug interactions, variability between people, adverse effects, the major drug classes across cardiovascular, anti-infective, analgesic, neurological, psychiatric, endocrine, immunological and oncological medicine, evidence-based medicine, trial methodology and its pathologies, drug development and regulation, patient safety, screening and overdiagnosis, and clinical ethics. A technical reference, not medical advice.
